author: Daniel Kornaś
text:
FlashVideo takes a staged route from a text prompt to 1080p video.

FlashVideo is a two-stage text-to-video generation repository for researchers and engineers experimenting with high-resolution video synthesis.

It helps you generate 1080p outputs by first producing 270p video, then enhancing it with a separate second-stage model.

Key features:
• Two-stage generation – separates prompt-to-270p synthesis from 270p-to-1080p enhancement.
• Released checkpoints – provides Stage I and Stage II weights plus 3D VAE setup instructions.
• Two inference paths – run prompts through a Jupyter notebook or a multi-GPU text-file script.
• Memory controls – adjust spatial and temporal VAE decoding slices for GPUs with less memory.
• Prompt guidance – includes a detailed example because both stages were trained with long prompts.

The code repository includes an Apache 2.0 license. The model weights use a separate CogVideoX license with registration requirements for commercial use.
